In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the classical and the quantum corrections are of the same form, and the quantum correction is of the same order as the classical one.

, in the long range regime, the spin-independent component of the scattering amplitude is determined by the classical potential, while the spin-dependent one by the classical potential plus a quantum correction.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the long distance behavior of gravitational scattering of massive spin 1/2 and spin 1 particles is determined by the classical potential and a universal quantum potential.
the spin-dependent long distance correction to the potential is the same as that of the spin-independent one.

the long range components of the scattering amplitudes are completely determined by the Newtonian potential, and the nonanalytic components are determined by the spin-dependent and the spin-independent long range components of classical scattering amplitudes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the long distance limit, the spin-dependent potential is always smaller than the spin-independent one.
, at the level of the scattering potential, the spin-dependent effects can be absorbed into a redefinition of the spin-independent one.
, for the case of spin, the classical and quantum contributions to the long range potential have different forms.
